name: What is the cost comparison between metal roofing and other durable options?

mainEntity.name: What is the cost comparison between metal roofing and other durable options?

acceptedAnswer.text: Metal roofing generally has a higher upfront cost than asphalt shingles but offers a significantly longer lifespan and lower lifetime costs. For example, a severe-weather metal roof might cost two to three times more initially than a premium asphalt shingle roof. However, its durability and resistance to harsh weather reduce repair frequency and replacement needs. When budgeting, consider the long-term savings from reduced maintenance and potential insurance premium discounts for impact-resistant roofing.
acceptedAnswer.description: Metal roofing has a higher upfront cost than asphalt shingles but offers lower lifetime costs due to its extended durability and reduced maintenance.
